title: Karthigai Deepam row: Police drag away protesters at Thirupparankundram

ai.summary: Hindu reports police removing protesters at Thiruparankundram who demanded the Tamil Nadu government follow court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam festival.

facts.claim: protesters demanded the Tamil Nadu government follow court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam festival
facts.quote: Hindu reports police removing protesters at Thirupparankundram who demanded the Tamil Nadu government follow court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam festival.

ai.background_note: The Tamil Nadu government is not obeying Madras High Court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankram Hill, leading to protests across the state in October 2026.
